ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white regions across both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped as a continuous serrated band along the trailing edge and a vertical cluster at the median notch. A distinct isolated circular black blob is located in the mid-lower section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle; the notch depth occupies roughly 1/10th of the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (2-6 pixels) forming a jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve; concave orientation adjacent to the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-relief pixel clusters with irregular borders at both distal tips, showing high contrast against the light ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy cluster of high-contrast textured anomalies at both fluke tips; one prominent isolated circular pigment marking on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation at the notch displays a specific 'forked' or 'anchor' geometry extending into the white field.
